acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:ed632c31-.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Authoring Experience
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:ed632c31-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta's growth. Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! The Authoring Experience team owns how Vanta tests are authored and deployed to customers, from the APIs and services underneath to the experiences built on top. As a Senior Backend Engineer on this team, you will own the services and public-facing customer APIs that turn Vanta's automation platform into products customers touch directly, stitching together systems across the platform to serve them well. What you’ll do as a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer at Vanta: - Own the architecture and rollout strategy for critical platform services, from initial design through large-scale rollout and migration. - Set the technical bar for how we design, publish, and maintain customer-facing APIs while owning things like security, reliability, and developer experience. - Stitch together services across Vanta's platform to serve customer-facing use cases, designing clear service boundaries and partnering closely with our data-platform teams on access patterns. - Raise the written design bar: drive RFCs and decision records that make architectural decisions durable and shared across the team. - Act as a force multiplier: mentor engineers up to your own level, expand the team's review capacity, and partner with your EM on team health and culture. - Build with TypeScript and Node.js on the backend, contribute to customer-facing experiences in React, and use AI tools to accelerate development and workflows. How to be successful in this role: - 8+ years of backend development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems. - You've designed and shipped external or public product APIs: contracts, versioning, authentication, and the developer experience around them. - You think in service boundaries and system design rather than any single layer of the stack, with enough data-layer fluency to partner well with dedicated platform teams. - You're comfortable working in a modern frontend codebase (we use React); you don't need to be an expert, but building product end to end is part of the day-to-day here. - Track record driving complex, ambiguous, multi-quarter initiatives to completion, directly and through others. - Experience rolling out or deprecating major systems safely at scale. - Strong written design communication and demonstrated mentorship; you multiply the engineers around you. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, MongoDB at scale, prior work in security or compliance products. bdg-bdg:lever:0721f802-78e0-4423-8669-71.description: Join BDG’s Experiential team, where we create elevated, high-impact, award-winning events at the country’s biggest cultural tentpoles — NYFW, Art Basel, Coachella, F1, and more. We’re looking for a strategic, creative, highly organized leader ready to own branded experiences from ideation through on-site execution, someone who thrives on the adrenaline of bringing big ideas to life in real time, and wants to help shape what’s next for experiential. Pre-Sale Lead ideation, scoping, and pitch strategy for custom events and brand activations across our stable of proprietary properties. Write and revise compelling pitch decks and RFP responses, shaping direction rather than just contributing to it. Partner with Creative, Sales, and Editorial to ground concepts in audience insight and brand strategy. A fast-paced go-getter with an out-of-the-box, marketing-minded approach — genuinely passionate about where experiential is headed. Skilled negotiator with proven budget and vendor management experience. Strategic thinker with strong creative instincts and excellent writing and visual storytelling skills. Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills. Highly dependable and collaborative across cross-functional teams. Highly organized, able to manage multiple high-stakes projects under tight deadlines. Proficient in Canva, Keynote, PowerPoint, MS Office, and Monday.com (or similar). Willing to travel and work nights/weekends as needed.

infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: ABOUT LABRYNTH Labrynth accelerates progress by streamlining regulatory complexity. We build AI-powered platforms that navigate complex regulations, generate audit-level documentation, and provide certainty, not shortcuts. Our technology serves clients navigating complex requirements across energy, infrastructure, compliance, and government. We operate as a forward-deployed engineering organization: small, high-velocity teams embedded directly with clients to rapidly discover needs and ship production-quality solutions. ABOUT HUBLAB In addition to Labrynth’s core platform, we’re also the technology partner behind HubLab, our major joint venture in Australia. HubLab has built a strong commercial engine through an extensive network of strategic partners that generates enterprise opportunities across the region. As demand grows, we’re expanding our customer-facing team across Melbourne and Sydney. This is a quota-carrying commercial role for someone who can build trusted relationships and close complex technology services. You’ll cultivate opportunities, join customers in person, explain the technology credibly, and close paid discovery engagements. HubLab and Labrynth’s discovery and implementation teams take ownership of technical discovery, solution design, customization, and delivery after the close. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Strategic Client Partner, AI & Technology based in Melbourne or Sydney to develop enterprise relationships and close paid discovery engagements that can lead to customized software and implementation by HubLab and Labrynth. You’ll bring technical credibility earned through prior implementation experience, but this is not a hands-on engineering or solution-design role. Your job is to make complex technology clear to nontechnical buyers, stand up to scrutiny from CTOs and technical leaders, and give clients confidence in the team behind the work. Most meaningful customer engagement happens in person. You’ll travel frequently, manage several opportunities and active client relationships at once, and stay commercially accountable from the first serious conversation through close, handoff, expansion, and renewal. The work spans three modes: - Connect: build and deepen relationships through your network, partner introductions, events, and consistent in-person engagement. - Translate: explain AI, software, data, cloud, integrations, security, and delivery approaches in language that works for both business and technical audiences. - Close and grow: advance opportunities to a paid discovery, make a clean handoff to the technical team, and return to close implementation, expansion, and renewal opportunities. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Switzerland. As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead complex, high-impact engineering programs that span multiple teams, systems, and technical domains. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, shaping program strategy and setting a high standard for execution across the organization. The role sits at the intersection of technical depth, strategic planning, and hands-on delivery, requiring you to work closely with engineers and product leaders. You will own scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs while ensuring critical initiatives remain on track. You will act as a trusted coordination point across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and go-to-market teams.
